implementation_values_g2.A_answer_used_for_v: A's parsed silent answer (not ground truth); invalid-format test states are excluded from the query sets and counted
implementation_values_g2.bridge: pcs7_silent.make_bridge (PCS2b StateToPrefixBridge, source_proj 128, hidden 1024, 4 slots); AdamW lr 3e-4 wd 0.01, batch 4, clip 1.0, 40 epochs, seed 20261021 for both arms (same init)
implementation_values_g2.objective: D1-b: 0.75 digit-restricted CE on (A answer + m) % 10 + 0.25 CE readback of A answer (lambda 0.25 for both arms)
implementation_values_g2.plain_arms: B_restart: P_B + v-definition + query (B never sees g); oracle: adds 'Intermediate result: v = <A answer>'; both via rq7._digit_readouts
implementation_values_g2.pool_and_splits: 1,600 episodes, P1_private_lookup generator from pcs7b_silent at seed 20261021; Random(20261021) shuffle -> 900 train / 200 val / 500 test
implementation_values_g2.random_prefix: Gaussian per test state, rescaled to the L2 norm of that state's PCS prefix; generator seeded by probe seed (0) and the state index
implementation_values_g2.seal: bridge sha256 and commitment sha256(bridge || 'GEN1-<arm>') written and verified before any evaluation control (wrong partners, random prefix) is built
implementation_values_g2.source_gate: silence verified; per-split format validity >= 95%; test parsed >= 400; A silent accuracy >= 0.80 (the PCS7b P1 qualification level); failure STOPS the run before any bridge is trained
implementation_values_g2.statistics: mon2_contract.cluster_bootstrap_mean over source states (10k, seed 0); mon2_contract.exact_mcnemar (Fraction-based, overflow safe) PCS vs each matched wrong state
implementation_values_g2.test_queries_per_state: primary 2 (REP: 2 m drawn from 5..9; COMP: both held-out combinations of v_A), seen 2 (drawn from the arm's allowed m), two_step 2 pairs (m1, m2) in 1..9 shared by both arms; draws seeded by sha of (seed, state, kind)
implementation_values_g2.token_identity_ceiling: deterministic A-answer + update; descriptive upper bound, no receiver call
implementation_values_g2.training_m: one allowed m per (state, epoch), cycling allowed[(index + epoch) % len(allowed)] where allowed depends on the state's A answer v_A: REP 1..4, COMP 1..9 minus the 2 held-out combinations of v_A
implementation_values_g2.two_step_prompt: 'Let v = g(d). Now e = (v + m1 + m2) % 10. What is e?' (the design's literal form); target (v_A + m1 + m2) % 10; never used in training
implementation_values_g2.validation_m: allowed[index % len(allowed)] (arm-specific, never a held-out m/combination), selection by minimum validation D1-b loss
implementation_values_g2.wrong_states: pcs7_silent._choose_wrong_partners on test states: 3 distinct partners with a different A answer, nearest source prompt token length, ties by index; swap target = partner A answer + the same update
